segments.en: It is day 2. Alex is still new on the team. Alex is new, so the team uses short sentences. In the morning, Maria helps me use the "file" and "folder" for a small task. During our chat, she says "Could you help me?" and "I need some help.". I answer clearly and ask one short question. After lunch, I work with the team on GitHub and practise "clone a repository" and "local copy". The task is small, but I understand a little more than yesterday.
